card.name: Words introducing a third party
card.fires_on: Small words such as he, who, their, a or very that start a clause about some other person, group or outside party, and also the word after 'and' naming foreign or other parties. It also fires on '/day' after a dose.

modes.label: Pronoun for a third party
modes.description: A pronoun such as he, who or their refers to someone other than the speaker.
modes.example: because<< he>> has no ownership rights to it.

modes.label: Outsider or foreign groups
modes.description: A word after 'and' names foreign or opposing groups or countries.

modes.label: Article before a drug class
modes.description: The word 'a' comes before a type of inhibitor in drug-interaction text.
modes.example: treatment with<< a>> weak inhibitor of CYP2C1

card.writes: It pushes away words for the other side, such as enemy and foreign, and toward words for our own side, such as ours and our country.
card.plain: It marks spots where the text is about someone else or the other side, and it nudges the next word away from 'them' words.
